basic_info.description: Located in SF's vibrant Excelsior & just steps from the natural beauty of McLaren Park, this inviting residence offers a rare blend of urban accessibility and peaceful retreat. Set on a quiet block, the home is filled w/natural light & showcases sweeping city views from multiple vantage points. The welcoming living room features a wall of windows, beautifully refinished original oak & parquet hardwood floors, and a classic wood-burning fireplace. A skylit, eat-in kitchen is updated w/granite countertops, high-end SS appliances, offering both style & functionality. Two main-level bedrooms enjoy tranquil garden outlooks & open directly onto a spacious, sunny view deck perfect for enjoying morning coffee or relaxing in the afternoon sun. The lower level features a private primary suite complete w/ensuite bathroom, ideal for guests or multi-generational living. Outdoor living is a highlight, with a multi-level deck and ample space to entertain or simply unwind. Off-street parking and a garage provide added convenience. Easy access to McLaren Park's miles of walking trails, this delightful home is a true hidden gem, combining warmth views & versatility in one of SF's most connected & sunny neighborhoods.
